stepBody: Find the best-selling home console and the best-selling handheld console of all time. Write Pandas code. The result can have any number of columns, but it must only have two rows corresponding to the best-selling home console and the best-selling handheld console. Assume that are no ties. You may only use one line of code. The resulting DataFrame must be assigned to the variable $$\text{best\_selling}.$$\n$$\text{best\_selling}$$ $$=$$ [blank]
